notes.title: Salsa-Virtual just unleashed a major upgrade!
notes.content:
Unleash Your Inner Salsa Superstar with Salsa-Virtual's Update! 🔥

Salsa-Virtual just unleashed an upgrade, it'll blow your dancing socks off.

But that's not all! We've got more surprises in store, more delights coming soon.

Play Salsa-Virtual now and unleash your inner salsa superstar once you unlock the best practice area yet!

Happy Gaming!

notes.title: Revamping of content
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Today we started our plan to revamp the Salsa-Virtual experience. We will mostly concentrate on content and better instruction, but we will also create easy to follow warm-ups so that you can get into dancing immediately instead of waiting until the end on a lesson plan.

We modified our workflow to record more reliable audio for our speech. It is incredibly difficult to do! The main challenge was to keep track of the music / rhythm / beats per minute, for two people, without actually playing it lest it be recorded as background noise instead of a separate track. A combination of bluetooth headsets, voice recorders, android devices, battery packs and some tape did the job.

Also, let us know if you're interested in an Oculus Quest release! The platform's performance constraints are a bit limiting, but we could eliminate some bells and whistles to make it fit without degrading the actual lessons.

Stay tuned for more updates!

Jorge & Bekah

notes.title: It's Here
notes.content:
Almost 2 years ago to the date we started going hard on developing Salsa-Virtual. 

There was much excitement as we pressed the "Release Now" button. Even more when STEAM said, "review and are you sure you want to publish?" And climaxed when we then had to type the text "Release my app."

Enjoy, Everyone! And we look forward to your feedback and making improvements.

Much love,
Rebekah & Jorge

notes.title: Mirror Fix
notes.content:

Early access launch is so close and we're super excited!
